Discover the stories behind renowned Japanese products alongside our reporter. This time.

Peppa spots a new playground! The children race over to it and discover that it's rather odd. Grampy Rabbit explains, this isn't a playground - it's an exercise park.
Daddy Pig thinks perhaps he should run the London Marathon to teach his children about determination! Daddy enlists Peppa and George to help with training in the park.
Daddy Pig's marathon training continues. There isn't long to go before the big day! Peppa takes the role as Daddy's coach and, with George, devises lots of fun games to help.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy.
Mr Elf has built a new boat to replace the one Big Bad Barry ate. He is nervous when the king commands him to take them on a cruise to a tropical paradise - will Big Bad Barry strike again.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
It's school project time for Peppa and her friends which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel have come to teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Mummy Pig has finally finished writing her first book and decides to take it to playgroup to read to the children with unexpected results.
Madame Gazelle takes the children on a trip to the Zoo where they get a tour from the zookeepers; Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
With a new baby on the way, Mummy and Daddy Pig realise they have run out of space at home! They decide to make their own home bigger with an extension.
Mr Bull arrives with his team to start work on Peppa's house renovation. Peppa and family move into the caravan in the garden while the work is being completed.
With the building work done, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick.
Mr Zebra arrives with a new car seat for the baby! Excited to try it in the car, the family soon realise it won't fit with Peppa and George too. It's time for a new car.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival - a jigsaw festival! Peppa is amazed by all of the completed jigsaws around the festival.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Thomas and Nia play with spare lights, excited to stay up all night to test them. But James thinks that goofing is a waste of time and is much too busy.
Paddington must keep his promise to not make a mess in 'Paddington's Goo Monster', then in 'Paddington's Apple Pip Adventure', Paddington and Simi go on a journey into the human body.
Mr Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake in 'Paddington and the Lake Monster', and in 'Paddington's Space Radio', Toq wants to let her dad know she's thinking of him up in space.
Paddington helps Mateo dress up in 'Paddington and the Three Musketeers', then in 'Paddington and the Dinosaur Hunt', Paddington, Simi and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt in the park.
Things go missing in Windsor Gardens in 'Paddington's Journey into a Black Hole', then in 'Paddington's Rainbow Race!', Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of rainbow.
After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car! Luckily, the bear family stop it just in time.
At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken bus. This is a job for Grampy Rabbit! Once fixed, Mummy Rabbit and Rebecca Rabbit arrive with a cake for Grampy Rabbit's birthday.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in an apartment above the shops. Peggi and Pandora Panda, and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family come to help make a garden on the roof of the apartments. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the apartment. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleepover - different friends in each of the apartments in the high street. So they play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus! Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Marjorie's House: Mysterious holes are appearing all over Ms. Marjorie's yard.
A really strong wind has suddenly swept up all the surfers in the Adventure Bay Windsurfing Race.
Paddington must keep his promise to not make a mess in 'Paddington's Goo Monster', then in 'Paddington's Apple Pip Adventure', Paddington and Simi go on a journey into the human body.
Mr Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake in 'Paddington and the Lake Monster', and in 'Paddington's Space Radio', Toq wants to let her dad know she's thinking of him up in space.
Lucky the dog's luck might have run out in 'Paddington's Lucky Day', then in 'Paddington the Pizza Chef', Baaz's niece Simi is visiting and he wants to create the perfect pizza for her.
Miss Cookie's class is out on a nature trail, in the Little Kingdom! It is up to Ben and Holly to prevent the elves and fairies being discovered.
Ben, Holly and their friends go on a snail trek with Miss Jolly.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel have come to teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
George has a new hat and Mummy Pig is determined that George doesn't get it muddy when visiting Grandpa and Granny Pig.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre and needs fixing, Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
During another visit to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house, Grandpa takes everyone to show them the new Bug Hotel he is building.
The Crew Demolishes A Rock Mountain: Speed Meister sabotages a speeding train, accidentally sending it towards a huge mountain! Rubble & Crew use their demolition vehicles to save the day.
Farmer Al's new machine goes haywire in 'Pups Stop the Garboni', then in 'Pups Save the Porcupine', the Paw Patrol catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.
Tim and Kai try to give Parky the best day ever.
Tim, Tommy & Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner.
Tim fakes it to prove he's just as cool as Kai's cousin.
Blaze and AJ are driving round the forest when they stumble upon a pair of special wheels offering super powers! And just in time, as Bots from outer space land in Axle City.
It's the big Mermaid Sparkle Party in Mermaid-lantis! But when the grumpy Kitty Squiddy tries to ruin the party for everyone, Gabby and Pandy must save the day.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
Ben and Holly want to play with Gaston the ladybird but he is missing. Nanny Plum uses her magic crystal ball to find him, and discover his daily routine is not what they thought.
Mr Zebra arrives with a new car seat for the baby! Excited to try it in the car, the family soon realise it won't fit with Peppa and George too. It's time for a new car.
Grandpa Pig found his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to leave! Peppa and Suzy look after him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new club house and slide for Peppa and her friends.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog take Peppa, George and Danny bowling. Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig have never been before.
Mummy Pig suggests they all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Mummy Pig has finally finished writing her first book and decides to take it to playgroup to read to the children with unexpected results.
Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and more.
Bubble goes on an adventure with Firefly in 'Wobbly Tooth', then in 'The Darkest Night', Gargamel creates a switch that can turn off all the lights so that he can find the Smurf village.
Big Hairy's little brother falls into a hole in 'Pups Save Little Hairy', then in 'Pups Save a Kooky Climber', Daring Danny tries extreme rock climbing with Ace Sorenson.
Four bite-sized adventures with the pups of the PAW Patrol.

Sandy takes on SpongeBob in a non-stop week of extreme sports in "Prehibernation Week.
Mysterious hooks appear in Bikini Bottom and Mr Krabs warns SpongeBob to stay away from them in 'Hooks', while in 'Mermaidman and Barnacleboy II' SpongeBob wins a big prize.
Mr Krabs wisely chooses SpongeBob and Patrick to decorate his living room in 'Wet Painters', and then in 'Krusty Krab Training Video', we learn about being an excellent employee.
SpongeBob's predecessor pays a visit to the Krusty Krab in 'The Original Fry Cook', and then in 'Night Light', tales of the boogeyman send SpongeBob into a panic.
SpongeBob becomes the richest Sponge in Bikini Bottom in 'Porous Pockets', and in 'Choir Boys', Squidward tries to avoid SpongeBob while on his way to an audition for the Bikini Bottom Men's Chorus.
SpongeBob and Patrick dig a tunnel between their two houses and drive Squidward nuts in 'That Sinking Feeling', and then in 'Karate Star', Patrick learns just enough karate to wreak havoc.
An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help.
It's Kamp Koral's first ever Wild West Day in 'A Finful of Sand Dollars', then in 'Cretins of the Night', SpongeBob and Patrick become vampires for a night.
The Dinghy cabin camps overnight without any water in 'High and Dry', then in 'The Beardsman', wilderness expert Paul Grunion visits the camp.
Squidward is sick, and SpongeBob worries that he has caught it too in 'Squiditis', then in 'Demolition Doofus', SpongeBob's bad driving makes him the star of the demolition derby.
A storm sweeps the Krusty Krab away in 'Mutiny on the Krusty', and then in 'The Whole Tooth', Patrick's last baby tooth needs to come out, but he's afraid to let it go.

Plankton hasn't tried to steal the secret formula in a while in 'Plankton Paranoia', then in 'Library Cards', Patrick discovers the pineapple's library, SpongeBob introduces him to the world of books.
SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick are split up into separate cabins in 'Helter Shelter', then in 'Reveille Revolution', Squidward has to earn back his morning 'Reveille' duties.
Nobby becomes too civilized for Narlene in 'My Fair Nobby', and in 'Gimme a News Break', Perch and his pal Harvey report the news of Kamp Koral, but they discover evidence of a conspiracy.
SpongeBob and Plankton must work together to survive in 'Delivery to Monster Island', then in 'Ride Patrick Ride', SpongeBob teaches Patrick how to ride a bike.
Patrick hires other Patricks to entertain at parties in 'Too Many Patricks', then in 'Much Tofu About Nothing', Pat-Thos shares a Hamdonian tale of love and pork products.
In Hamdonia, Prince Shmeat and Tofu Todd embark on a quest to defeat the Maw in 'Braggin' Slayer', and in 'Scaredy Pat', after learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.
..Secrets: Uncover everything we know so far about the legendary Krabby Patty as Perch Perkins investigates the burger's history, ingredients, secrets, scandals and successes.
Sandy creates a new invention to avoid doing chores in 'Are You Smarter Than A Smart Cabin', and then in 'Deep Sea Despot', Squidward takes over as Camp Master.
Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral in 'Help Not Wanted', then in 'Camp Spirit', SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper.
SpongeBob makes a delivery to E.V.I.L. in 'Delivery of Doom', then in 'My Father the Boat', Pearl gets a new boat.

The Patricks compete for control of the TV remote in 'Pat-Tathlon', then in 'Upturn's Downturn', after driving over Patrick, a court order forces Lady Upturn to live with the Star family.
Some undersea superheroes are back in 'Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy III', and then in 'Squirrel Jokes', SpongeBob's derogatory comedy is not at all funny to Sandy Squirrel.
The Patrick Show gets competing sponsors in 'The Patrick Show Sells Out', then in 'Neptune's Ball', the Star family visits King Neptune's palace.
In an episode about boats, Cecil teaches Patrick how to drive in 'Driven to Drive', then in 'A Patty in Time', Patrick time-travels in a race for the Krusty Krab's newest menu item.
Mr Krabs makes his number one employee take his first ever day off, in 'Bummer Vacation', and then in 'Wig Struck', SpongeBob finds an old wig, and wears it all around town, thinking that it's cool.
The weekly food delivery truck goes missing in 'Quest for Tire', and in 'A Cabin of Curiosities', a mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark.
Gary's new habit causes a night of stress in 'Un-Breaking and De-Entering', then in 'Swimmin' Holed', Narlene and Nobby's secret swimming hole is exposed.
Patrick decides it's time to start living life like Larry the Lobster in 'A Life In A Day', and then in 'Sun Bleached', SpongeBob tries to get a tan, with disappointing results.
SpongeBob and Patrick see a young Mermaidman and Barnacleboy in 'Back To The Past', and then there are more classic superhero adventures in 'The Bad Guy Club For Villains'.
GrandPat prevents his precious memories from being sold at a family yard sale.
Bunny sends Squidina to camp, so Patrick works with new staff in 'Is there a Director in the House?', then in 'Star Cruise', the Star family enjoys a cruise ship vacation... in outer space.
Mr Krabs resorts to desperate measures after Plankton drives away his customers in 'Free Samples', and then in 'Home Sweet Rubble', SpongeBob's pineapple is falling apart, and needs re-modelling.
When Gary gets lost outside, he has to go on an incredible journey to get back home in 'Food Con Castaways', and then in 'Snail Mail', Spongebob accidentally fibs to his pen pal, and must keep it up.
The Dinghies travel to outer space in 'Hats Off to Space', then in 'In a Nut's Shell', After discovering his empty shell, Narlene and Nobby disguise themselves at Camp Master Krabs.
SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy decide to turn their cabin into a pirate ship in 'Camp Crossbones', then in 'A Jelly Life', SpongeBob pretends to be a jellyfish for research purposes.
Patrick is mistaken for a corporate retreat leader in 'Retreat!', then in 'Sidekick Search', Patrick and Squidina hold auditions for a Patrick Show sidekick.
Bubble Bass reviews The Patrick Show in 'Bubble Bass Reviews', and then in 'Patrick's Prison Pals', Bunny brings Patrick to prison for Bring Your Kid To Work Day.
Two foes take a road trip together in 'BassWard', then in 'Squidiot Box', Squidward gets lost in the imagination box.

Bikini Bottom is inhabited entirely by robots in 'Welcome to Binary Bottom', money is on the line in 'You're Going To Pay... Phone', and 'GrandPat travels through time to get home in 'A Skin Wrinkle'.
Patrick hosts a countrified variety show. in 'Sea Haw', then in 'Li'l Past-cals', The Kelpbed Kids travel to the future to get their kicking can back.
Squidina hosts a television show to pass a home economics class in 'Home Ecch', and then in 'Fun and Done', Patrick and SpongeBob try to unlock a dull child's imagination.
Patrick and Squidina follow a runaway idea brick into Randomland in 'All Out of Idea Bricks', then in 'A Fool Schooled', the family provide home-schooling for Patrick.
When SpongeBob cooks at home, Mr. Krabs' customers leave his restaurant in 'SpongeBob's Place', then in 'Plankton Gets the Boot', Plankton gets kicked out of the house.
Krabs turns the Krusty Krab into a jail after Plankton breaks the law in 'The Krusty Slammer', then in 'Pineapple RV', SpongeBob and Patrick turn the pineapple into a mobile home for a road trip.
Bad reviews lead to trouble in the Krusty Krab in 'Bulletin Board', and then in 'Sandy's Nutmare', Sandy creates the latest acorn-based food sensation, but her tree pays the price for her greed.
Squidward becomes the star of his own public access TV show in 'Tentacle-Vision', and then in 'I Heart Dancing', Squidward tries to sabotage SpongeBob's big dance audition.
Squidward gets busted for speeding in his boat (which isn't a speedboat) and is sent back to boating school in 'Boating Buddies'. Then in 'The Krabby Kronicle', Mr Krabs sets up his own newspaper.
Plankton turns everyone into babies in 'Goo Goo Gas', and then in 'Le Big Switch', SpongeBob switches places with a snooty French chef at a high-end restaurant.
